formula: ewm_mean(return | volume_change>0) - ewm_mean(return | volume_change<0) over span=20
code:
def factor_volume_confirmed_ewm_mean_diff(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    vol_change = df_copy["volume"].pct_change().replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    up_mask = vol_change > 0
    down_mask = vol_change < 0
    up_ret_sum = (ret * up_mask).ewm(span=20, min_periods=10).sum()
    up_count = up_mask.ewm(span=20, min_periods=10).sum()
    down_ret_sum = (ret * down_mask).ewm(span=20, min_periods=10).sum()
    down_count = down_mask.ewm(span=20, min_periods=10).sum()
    up_mean = up_ret_sum / up_count.replace(0, np.nan)
    down_mean = down_ret_sum / down_count.replace(0, np.nan)
    factor = up_mean - down_mean
    df_copy["factor_volume_confirmed_ewm_mean_diff"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_volume_confirmed_ewm_mean_diff"]
description: Preserves the parent's price-volume coherence core: conditional mean difference between returns on volume expansion days and volume contraction days. The mutation replaces the simple rolling window with exponentially weighted moving averages (EWMA) with span=20. This gives more weight to recent price-volume interactions, potentially improving ICIR and responsiveness while keeping the same economic mechanism. The raw signal remains continuous and suitable for cross-sectional analysis.
